documentation.file_docstring:
Webhook notifications for policy violations and governance events.

Sends POST requests to configured webhook endpoints when policy violations,
budget warnings, or other governance events are detected.
member_docstrings: WebhookConfig: Configuration for a webhook endpoint.
WebhookEvent: A governance event to send via webhook.
DeliveryRecord: Record of a webhook delivery attempt.

_matches: Check if a config subscribes to the given event type.
_send: Send a single event to a single webhook endpoint with retries.
notify: Send event to all matching webhooks synchronously.
notify_async: Send event to all matching webhooks in a background thread.
notify_violation: Convenience method to notify about a policy violation.
notify_budget_warning: Convenience method to notify about a budget warning.
